description.value: A functional MRI study examined cue-induced brain activation in abstinent alcohol-dependent patients and healthy controls, and its association with subsequent relapse and alcohol intake.

spans.text: We used functional magnetic resonance imaging and visual alcohol-associated and control cues to assess brain activation in ten abstinent alcoholics and control subjects.

value: cue-induced activation of the striatum, ACC and mPFC, rather than overt craving, is associated with an increased relapse risk of abstinent alcoholics
